label: Iridium Ground Control
info:
Receives Mobile Originated messages from Ground Control (RockBLOCK / Iridium SBD).

Delivery address to set in RockBLOCK Core:
  http://<this-host>:1880/rockblock/mo

Ground Control requires HTTP 200 within 3 seconds or it retries with a doubling backoff for about six days, so the response is sent immediately and parsing happens on a separate branch.

Set your IMEI in the 'set imei' node, then Deploy.

View what has arrived:

The 200 is sent on its own branch so parsing can never push the response past Ground Control's 3-second limit.

'data' is hex-encoded. It is decoded to text only when the result is printable, otherwise the hex is kept as-is.
